name: LinkedIn jobs daily digest to Slack and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## LinkedIn jobs: daily new-jobs digest to Slack and Google Sheets
Every morning, search public LinkedIn job listings (no login) for your keywords and location. Only jobs not seen before are appended to the sheet and posted to Slack as a single digest message.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Credentials > New > *Header Auth*. Name it `Apify API token`. Header name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (token: Apify Console > Settings > Integrations).
2. Open the Google Sheets node(s), connect Google Sheets OAuth2, and replace `YOUR_SHEET_ID` (and the tab name if needed).
3. Slack node: create a Slack credential, replace `YOUR_CHANNEL_ID`. Delete the Slack branch if you only want the sheet.
4. Edit `keywords`, `location`, `datePosted`, `maxItems` in *Run Apify actor*.
5. Click *Execute workflow* to test with the small sample input, then activate.

Runs the Apify actor https://apify.com/transparent_meteorite/linkedin-public-jobs (pay-per-result; the free Apify plan credit covers a trial). Maintained by the author of the actor.
